nodes.title: Search interface
nodes.summary: Accepts a query and displays the records found.

rules.title: Empty query
rules.text: An empty query does not trigger a search.

nodes.detailNote: In this example the screen components are not expanded.

nodes.title: Search service
nodes.summary: Validates the query, finds records and returns an ordered result.

children.title: Request handling
children.summary: Validates parameters, passes the query to computation and builds the response.

rules.title: Result limit
rules.text: The number of returned records is limited by a query parameter.

children.detailNote: The transport protocol is not specified in the example.

children.title: Search computation
children.summary: Retrieves candidates from the index and ranks them by the query.

children.title: Candidate retrieval
children.summary: Requests matching catalog records and passes them to ranking.
children.detailNote: A specific index query language is not chosen.

children.title: Ranking
children.summary: Computes the candidate order by the query text and parameters.

rules.title: Equal scores
rules.text: When scores are equal, a deterministic order by record key is preserved.

children.detailNote: The internal scoring formula is beyond the scope of the example.

nodes.title: Catalog index
nodes.summary: Stores published records and returns candidates for a query.
nodes.detailNote: A specific storage technology is not chosen.

nodes.title: Catalog provider
nodes.summary: Publishes prepared records into the index through an agreed write interface.
nodes.detailNote: The external system is described only within the scope of publishing records.

relations.label: Find records
relations.payload: Query text, filters and result count limit.
relations.meaning: The owner initiates a search through the interface.

relations.label: Validated query
relations.payload: Normalized text and filters for candidate selection.
relations.meaning: Candidate retrieval uses the validated query parameters.

relations.label: Validated query
relations.meaning: Ranking uses the context of the same query.

relations.label: Record selection
relations.payload: Search criteria and the maximum candidate set size.
relations.meaning: The component requests candidates from the index.

relations.label: Candidates
relations.meaning: The index returns the records found for further processing.

relations.label: Records to score
relations.meaning: Candidates are passed to the result ordering computation.

relations.label: Ordered records
relations.payload: Record keys and their scores in result order.
relations.meaning: The handler receives the computation result and builds the response.

relations.label: Search result
relations.payload: A limited list of records found with display data.
relations.meaning: The interface shows the query result.

relations.label: Catalog records
relations.meaning: The provider updates the index contents through the write interface.

relations.label: Publication state
relations.payload: The identifier of the accepted publication or an explicit rejection.
relations.meaning: The provider learns whether the submitted set of records was accepted.
